event.description: staged prune FF width from 10 to 9 with extended schedule
event.proposal: Parameterization-preserving structured compression with optimization adaptation: prune one lowest-ranked neuron per block from width 10 to 9 and extend the cosine fine-tuning cap from 10,000 to 20,000 steps because the width-10 curve was still improving as its learning rate vanished near the qualification boundary.
